Align observed fish behaviour to event-relative functional time

Source: R/functional-event-tanks.R
aqt_functional_event_grid.Rd

Interpolates only between adjacent *observed* source samples separated by at most max_gap_s. Missing source frames, insufficient coverage and large gaps are never silently bridged. The time grid is in REAL seconds relative to externally logged event onset, not warped to 0..1. Grouped fish remain distinct; tank_id/treatment can be retained as observational metadata, not treated as independent fish replicates.

Usage

aqt_functional_event_grid(
  data,
  events,
  outcome = "speed",
  grid_s = seq(-5, 5, length.out = 21L),
  max_gap_s = 0.5
)

Arguments

data

Long frame with session_id, camera_id, track_id, time_s, numeric outcome and optional logical observed, tank_id, treatment.

events

Canonical events, at most one per session.

outcome

Numeric observed variable such as speed, x, y or z.

grid_s

Strictly increasing finite event-relative seconds.

max_gap_s

Largest permissible adjacent observation gap.

Value

aqt_functional_event_grid with supported and missing grid points.
